# SimasiaAI

> SimasiaAI (Σημασία-ΑΙ Ι.Κ.Ε., Athens, Greece) is a Greek AI company with a social-impact focus. Its one product, fλow (also written "flow"), is an AI assistant + CRM for people who care for others: NGOs, patient associations, disability services, doctors, practices, polyclinics and clinics in Greece and Cyprus. fλow has three parts: DialogosAI (AI assistant that answers patients, families and members 24/7 only from the organisation's approved sources, with citations), PraxisAI (CRM: member/patient cards, appointments, expiries, reminders, follow-ups) and MetronAI (analytics: what people ask, unmet needs, reports for teams and sponsors). EU AI Act and GDPR compliant, EU-hosted, WCAG-accessible. It never gives medical advice. NGOs from €119/month; clinics from €149/month (annual). Motto: «Μέτρο μας ο Άνθρωπος» (The human is our measure).

Key facts: implementations with Κάπα3 («Μυρτώ», cancer navigator), ΠΟΑμΣΚΠ («ΣΚΠ-i», Multiple Sclerosis), Ήρωες της BPAN («BPAN Companion», 60 languages) and Perfectaki Able (accessible education). Pharma/CSR sponsors can fund fλow for an NGO. Contact: contact@simasiaai.gr.

## Product

- [fλow](https://www.simasiaai.gr/flow): the product page: DialogosAI + PraxisAI + MetronAI, who it is for, a day with fλow, pricing for NGOs and clinics
- [Go with the fλow](https://www.simasiaai.gr/go): build your own fλow, get an instant offer, send a message or book a 30-minute call (/go#book)
- [fλow for practices and clinics](https://www.simasiaai.gr/ypodochi): digital reception for doctors: plans Απαντάει, Κλείνει, Φέρνει πίσω, Σηκώνει το τηλέφωνο; live in 48 hours or free
- [fλow platform](https://www.simasiaai.gr/platform): entry to the fλow client platform (coming soon)
